system_design_understanding.comment: Exemplary understanding of vertical vs horizontal scaling, range vs hash partitioning, partition pruning, and O(1) lifecycle management.

implementation_quality.comment: Implemented PostgreSQL declarative range partitioning on click telemetry with monthly child partitions, automatic tuple routing, and partition indexes.

verification_rigor.comment: All 5 automated tests in verify_module_09.py passed; empirically verified partition pruning in EXPLAIN plans, cross-partition aggregation, and O(1) partition detachment.

tradeoff_analysis.comment: Detailed analysis comparing in-engine declarative partitioning against distributed sharding, primary key constraints, and vacuum overhead reduction.
